identity.name: SA Server Update Roadmap
identity.description: Planned server updates and migrations for SA clients — Kanban-style roadmap.

goals: Execute planned server updates and migrations for SA clients on schedule
Minimise downtime and client disruption during server transitions
Maintain a clear, visible roadmap of upcoming server work

milestones.name: Server update roadmap published and visible to stakeholders
All planned SA server migrations complete

risks.description: Server migration causes unexpected client downtime or data issues
risks.mitigation: Pre-migration testing; rollback plan for every update; client communication before and after

dependencies.description: Server updates must not break V8 client installations

notes: Kanban-style project owned by Peer Thanesh. Tracks planned server updates and migrations for SA clients. Each update is its own card — the project is a roadmap, not a backlog.
